story.title: Arriving in New York
story.situation: Arriving at JFK Airport and completing the essential arrival process before leaving the airport.
story.summary: Jieun arrives in New York at JFK Airport, follows the arrival process, handles practical airport interactions, collects her baggage, and prepares to continue her journey into the city.

carry_in_state: Jieun has just arrived in New York for her trip.
carry_out_state: Jieun has completed the airport arrival process.
Jieun is ready to leave JFK Airport and travel into New York City.
